item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 03/May/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong today. There will be a few showers over the region. Upper-air disturbances will bring showers and thunderstorms to southern China over the weekend. Under the influence of a southerly airstream, the weather will be hot during the day and brighter over Guangdong on Monday and Tuesday. Another surge of the easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. There will be one or two showers over the region.
